crm_notes:
- Company background: mid-stage CCaaS SaaS provider focused on SMB+mid-market support stacks.
- Primary ask: robust agent-assist + accurate ticket summarization with auditable citations; must support multi-source RAG (Zendesk, Confluence, internal KBs, attachment parsing).
- Traffic profile: daily 50k incoming tickets, peak spikes 4x during product launches; target 95th percentile reply latency < 350ms for agent-assist suggestions.
- Throughput target: sustain 500 concurrent agent sessions with real-time suggestions (avg 40 tokens/sugg).
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for private deployment + predictable unit costs; looking to compare Redwood Dedicated vs private on prem.
- Model preferences: open Llama-3-class models or Redwood-verified variants; want reranking layer for citation accuracy; support for quantized weights to reduce footprint.
- RAG specifics: multi-index retrieval, per-suggestion citation block, freshness windowing (must prioritize KB updates <24h), deterministic fallback to canonical docs.
- Tool-calling: urgent need for secure tool-calls to internal ticketing APIs (create/update ticket, escalate, add private note). Must include strong auth and audit trails.
- Reliability needs: autoscaling across AZs, degrade gracefully to cached answers + link to canonical doc when upstream vector store slow.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS for keys, audit logs with 1-year retention minimum, data residency in us-east and eu-west regions.
- Quote from CTO: "We can't ship a model that hallucinates links — we need citation-first answers and rollback if freshness is questionable."
- Demo feedback: retrieval precision good on small corpus; issues found on attachments parsing (PDF tables) and with reranker latency under burst.
- POC ask: 2-week pilot ingesting 18 months of ticket history, live replay of 2k tickets/day, integration with staging Zendesk instance, and stress test to 2M vector ops/day.
- Commercial: looking at $150k-$500k ARR depending on SLA and on-prem support.
- Notes style: short bullets, action items, and quoted snippets from call transcripts.
recent_activity_summary: Call cadence weekly; security questionnaire open; pilot env requested; Rafael to send pilot onboarding checklist. CSM to prepare success criteria doc.
technical_requirements:
- RAG: multi-source connectors (Zendesk, Confluence, S3 attachments), per-result citation + provenance.
- Freshness: incremental ingest + TTL policies, immediate delta indexing for priority docs.
- Latency SLO: 95p < 350ms for suggestion generation; 99p < 800ms preferred for full ticket summarization.
- Scale: support vector store growth to 50M vectors w/ sharding + hot/cold tiers.
- Failover: route to lightweight caching tier or smaller model when heavy load detected.
- Observability: token-level cost & latency breakdown, per-route tracing, error attribution for hallucinations.
poC_scope: 2-week pilot: ingestion (18 months), staging Zendesk integration, attachment parsing, reranker tuned for precision>0.85, run synthetic spike test to 4x baseline. Success criteria: avg suggestion latency < 350ms, citation precision > 85%, no PII leakage in outputs.
commercial_notes: Prefers term license for Private with annual commit. Legal expects data residency clause and indemnity for PII incidents. Finance to review pricing slab for 500 concurrent agent seats.
